subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Bangladesh is home to diverse natural sites which reflect the country's rich environmental heritage. The Sundarbans is one of them. It is the largest mangrove forest in the world. It is also well known for the habitat of Royal Bengal Tiger. It got recognition as a World Heritage Site. The sea-beach of Cox's Bazar is the longest sea-beach in the world. It is really wonderful to enjoy sun-set scene with natural beauty on the sea-beach. Bangladesh covers varieties of beauty by offering hills, forests and green plain. Jaflong is also a beautiful landscape.
